summary: Confirmed on the operator page and Campspot: RV $45/night ($46.58 with the 3.5% booking fee on Campspot, Nov 2026, weekday and Saturday alike), weekly $300, monthly by phone; 30/50A full hookups, pull-throughs to 50 ft; military discount stated. Pond measured ~0.6 ha (under 5 acres = pond), Osage River ~225 m east past a field and houses: not waterfront stands. Fees (manual) left as stored. Season not stated.
flags: PRICE GATE: $45 site charge (+3.5% booking fee = $46.58), under US$50; no gateway needed. Google Maps 4.4 over 122 reviews; RV Life 4* over 15 (under 25 reviews).

Waterfront (stays not waterfront): the pond SE of the office measures about 105 x 80 m on imagery (~0.6 ha, ~1.5 acres) - a pond under 5 acres, no value. The Osage River lies ~225 m east of the easternmost RV pads, with a field, a lane and a row of riverside houses between; no site sees it.

Long-stay leaning (operator markets weekly $300 and monthly by phone). Five tests: (1) price PASS $45; (2) nights for sale PASS, Campspot sells one night; (3) no minimum PASS; (4) nightly share PASS - Campspot showed 10 free sites (8 W/E back-ins near the pond, 2 pull-throughs) on Tue 2026-11-17 and Sat 2026-11-21, the full-hookup back-in type fully taken, against ~50 sites (RV Life count) - about 20%; (5) RV park, no homes sold PASS. Reviews: RV Life 7/2026 (rated 4/10) 'Arrived to no attendant... Not many transit trailers, all local some with lots unmoved'; 7/2026 (6/10) 'Run down: Arrived to no office. Campsite given was occupied. Called number and got a recording!'; 6/2026 (10/10) 'The campground is good... just off the main road to Jefferson City'. Read as mixed long-stay/transient, not iffy enough to drop on Google 4.4/122; flagged for AWH.
